heroSubtitle: FlowSoundz Radio introduces independent, AI-assisted, and virtual artists through curated rotation, artist spotlights, and radio-style launch moments.

valueCards.title: Underground discovery
valueCards.text: FlowSoundz turns unknown songs into curated discovery moments, so listeners hear artists with context instead of getting lost in endless playlists.

valueCards.title: Why listeners use it
valueCards.text: Use FlowSoundz for curated rotation, artist spotlights, and radio-style launch moments that make discovery feel intentional.
